services_shape: self-pay visits, each with a nurse by name and a set length; a first IV starts with a screening call; add-ins are added at the visit only with the client's yes; a pack is paid in full; a membership is charged monthly only after the member's yes
questions_before_times: a hydration IV, a vitamin IV, an add-in or a pack
which visit: the clinic's own list only, never a symptom typed into the AI
paying yourself (every visit is self-pay; no health plan pays)
for a video screening: the state the client will be in
join the list for a sooner time
safety_stop: chest pain, a racing or irregular heartbeat, fainting, or trouble breathing
swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, hives with wheezing, or a seizure
a fever of 100.4 or more, or vomiting today
a swallowed medicine, or too much of one
license: the owner's word: each nurse, nurse practitioner and the medical director holds their own license, and the clinic its registration, where the state's form asks; Rosie never looks a license up
staff_skills: Tessa (registered nurse): IV starts and drips at the clinic; Owen (nurse practitioner): screening calls and first-visit checks; Jade (registered nurse) and Kai (nurse practitioner): mobile IVs at home under the medical director's standing order; the front desk: no clinical OKs
messages_never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the treatment, the blend, a symptom, a medicine or a condition; flow A's texts drop the nurse's name; at a home visit the nurse's name stays, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
